callees.name: _find_brace_end
callees.pre_condition: lines is a list of source code lines. open_brace_line is a valid 0-based index into lines where an opening brace '{' resides.
callees.post_condition: Returns the 0-based index of the matching closing brace '}', accounting for nested brace pairs at any depth. The returned index is strictly greater than open_brace_line and strictly less than the length of lines.

callees.name: _extract_func_name_brace
callees.pre_condition: sig_text is a string containing a candidate function signature spanning one or more concatenated lines. lang_cfg is a dict with language-specific keyword and prefix configuration.
callees.post_condition: Returns the bare function name extracted from sig_text, using language-specific keyword filtering from lang_cfg to separate the name from return types, parameter lists, and qualifiers. Returns None when sig_text does not contain a recognizable function declaration for the language.
